title: 第二十五章 呼吸法和剑术第二十六章 有一个算一个都是垃圾
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: 见李奥正在认真思考，伊芙直接离开，“我还有事要处理，我这间修炼室你随时可以来用。
现在的你和我一样，我是骑士境界，准骑士的身份，而你则是准骑士的实力。
我父亲和其他几个骑士差不多还有一个多月才回来。
等他们回来才能举行册封仪式，所以你还没法去骑士大厅进行准骑士训练。
先帮我在剑室看着那群小鬼吧。
另外，这段时间我会很忙，剑室那边如果有大事就来骑士大厅找我。”
接下来这半个月，城堡里只有她一个骑士实力的坐镇。
父亲让她暂时负责管理城里的大小事务。
虽然这座巨石搭建的城堡固若金汤，但是物资贫乏的冬季，向来是各种案件的高发期。
她刚刚突破骑士境界，准备到城镇里看看有没有不开眼的小偷或者抢劫犯，抓一个杀鸡儆猴。
至于李奥，她已经将熔炉呼吸法和最高阶的剑法都教给了他。
能不能有所成就，就看他接下来的悟性和毅力了。
对于自己这唯一的学生，她基本是满意的。
脑瓜子聪明，天赋也不错。
就是有时太过内敛，或者说，有点怂，少了一丝血性。
昨天她在外面看了半天，那群克拉森的学生都已经动手了，他当时却没有回应，而是打算走。
这让她有些不太满意。
这也是她看不下去最终出手的主要原因。
“或许是由于他的出身，让他谨慎有余，气魄不足。”伊芙此时想着。
“如果有人能陪他对练给他一些压力，让他长长胆量，也许会对他的成长更有帮助。”伊芙一路走一路琢磨，突然想起了远在千里之外的妹妹。
想起了当年她们两姊妹竞争，或者说是争斗的场景。
她能有今天的实力，一部分原因要归功于这个天赋比她更出众的妹妹。
也是因为这个妹妹的常年打压，让她现在事事都很在意别人的肯定。
“倒是突然有些想这丫头了，不知道她在黄金骑士团里过的怎么样。”伊芙不自觉地看向了丹伦王国的方向。
伊芙走后，李奥一个人在修炼室，他开始研究起自己的面板。
【李奥
职业：马夫（白）、剑手（绿）
未就职职业：剑术专家（蓝）
呼吸法：熔炉呼吸法第一阶段1100
特性：马语者（白）、磨砺（白）
content_en:
Seeing that Leo was thinking seriously, Eve left directly, "I still have things to deal with, and you can use my training room at any time.
You are the same as me now. I am in the realm of knights and have the status of a quasi-knight, while you have the strength of a quasi-knight.
It will be more than a month before my father and several other knights come back.
The canonization ceremony can't be held until they come back, so you can't go to the knight hall for quasi-knight training yet.
Please help me keep an eye on those brats in the sword room first.
In addition, I will be very busy during this period. If there is anything important in the Sword Room, come to the Knight Hall to find me. "
In the next half month, she was the only one with the strength of a knight in the castle.
Her father put her in charge of the city's affairs for the time being.
Although this castle built of huge rocks is impregnable, winter, when supplies are scarce, has always been a period of high incidence of various cases.
She had just broken through the realm of knighthood and was going to the town to see if there were any blind thieves or robbers, and to catch one to scare the monkeys.
As for Leo, she has taught him the furnace breathing technique and the highest level sword technique.
Whether he can achieve anything depends on his subsequent understanding and perseverance.
She was basically satisfied with her only student.
He has a smart mind and good talents.
It's just that sometimes he is too restrained, or in other words, a little timid and lacks a trace of bloodiness.
She watched outside for a long time yesterday, and the group of Klassen students had already taken action, but he did not respond at that time, but planned to leave.
This made her a little dissatisfied.
This was also the main reason why she couldn't stand it anymore and finally took action.
"Maybe it's because of his background that he is more cautious than courageous." Eve was thinking at this time.
"If someone can accompany him to sparring to give him some pressure and make him courageous, it may be more helpful for his growth." Eve thought about it all the way, and suddenly thought of her sister thousands of miles away.
It reminds me of the scene where the two sisters competed or fought.
Part of the reason why she is what she is today is due to her sister who is more talented than her.
It is also because of this sister's constant suppression that she now cares about others' approval in everything.
"I suddenly missed this girl. I wonder how she was doing in the Golden Knights." Eve unconsciously looked in the direction of the Kingdom of Danlun.
…
After Eve left, Leo was alone in the training room, and he began to study his panel.

Spirit: 1.4

Unemployed occupation: Swordsmanship expert (blue)
Breathing Technique: The First Stage of Furnace Breathing Technique 1100
Traits: Horse Whisperer (white), Sharpening (white)
